title: SR-1.11 memev stop always ends inside its bound
request: Closes G11: REV-022 AC03 is a real flake: stop takes 5.2 s on 2 vCPU and the daemon is SIGKILLed mid shutdown-sync. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Root cause and fix
requirements: the shutdown sync is cancelled at its deadline, child git processes are killed, and the daemon exits before SIGKILL
the 4.8 s bound in the test is unchanged
the 20-run check prints the CPU count, the CPU model and the 1-minute load with its result, so a timing read on other hardware is labelled

criteria.statement: The stop test passes 20 runs in a row on a 2 vCPU machine

verifier.cmd: for i in $(seq 1 20); do out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='REV-022' test/sync-schedule.test.mjs 2>&1) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='REV-022' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }' || exit 1; done
